prompts.v3:
Edit this generated industrial-site concept into a DENSE TACTICAL INDUSTRIAL COMPOUND rather than a spacious business park. Preserve the five major building/region positions, their size and design, the aerial north-up composition, the central reactor hall and its red/grey facade, north office, west workshop, east pump facility, southeast loading building, northwest L-shaped pedestrian bridge, perimeter fence, and finite site extent. Do not add new big landmark buildings.
Crucial change: the open ground BETWEEN buildings must offer short protected moves for people, not huge vulnerable empty ground. Fill the SOUTHWEST empty landscaped island with a coherent maintenance reserve compound: one small low service shed, 2 organized banks of old heavy electrical cabinets/transformers, a steel storage rack under a short lean-to canopy, a modest concrete dividing wall, with walkable winding passages between. Keep the outer road unobstructed.
Along INNER ring roads, at building corners and between entrances, add a visibly continuous sequence of realistic solid cover clusters on the sidewalks/verges: concrete knee-to-chest-high barrier walls 1.2–1.6 m high, short steel equipment enclosures around 2 m high, pump-valve shelters, grouped electrical cabinets and utility kiosks. Use these to break long straight views every roughly 8–12 m along PEDESTRIAN routes, linked with curb islands and occasional short covered walkways. Cover must be substantial opaque objects, NOT just trees or railings. Keep 2–3 m clear pedestrian paths and visible exits at every gap. Avoid random evenly scattered crates.
Break the wide exposed southern approach into two offset pedestrian approaches flanking a small gate/checkpoint service island and concrete barricades; preserve access to the central main door. Add vehicle-scaled cover (parked service van / utility truck) only at sensible loading or repair locations. Make the north office approach similarly protected by planter-backed concrete walls and services. The main roads remain 6–8 m visually clear for vehicles; cover sits beside them or creates deliberate short chicanes at junctions, never seals a route.
Grey concrete/metal industrial unity, restrained red accents, muted vegetation mainly at the perimeter, detailed drains/cables/racks. Daylight readability, no logos or extra text. This is a visual concept only: do not draw dimensions or claim measured distances.
